verdict.rationale: Dropbox ships a first-party e-signature product, Dropbox Sign, that works where the files live. Plans include "Edit PDFs and get signatures", and Dropbox lets users "sign documents—without leaving Dropbox". Signature requests can be sent from Dropbox with signed documents saved back to storage, and a documented eSignature API (Send Signature Request) is available. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-Dropbox signing workflow, and deeper documentation of signing features such as templates and audit trails within the evidence.
